wikipedia-42863588.evidence: Official game soundtrack product credits identify Lucas Pope as artist and composer; label 3909.
wikipedia-42863588.verification: Publisher soundtrack credits; this is Return of the Obra Dinn, not a tribute arrangement.

wikipedia-36531769.evidence: Devolver Digital original Hotline Miami Official Soundtrack playlist description lists the nine contributing artists. Links to Steam app 219150 identify the original 2012 game.
wikipedia-36531769.verification: Publisher source; original Hotline Miami rather than the 2015 sequel. Credits are contributing musicians, not a claim of one commissioned composer.

lumines.evidence: Publisher release credits: all tracks composed by Takayuki Nakamura except Square Dance, My Generation and 45 Degrees by Katsumi Yokota. Audio mixing matches 2005 Lumines Remixes on shared tracks.
lumines.verification: Publisher original score credits, independently corroborated by lead composer official site https://nktk.net/ describing 2004 Puzzle Fusion. Licensed vocal songs have separate authors; do not credit those to this pair. This 2026 album is not itself a 2004 release.

workbook-09-29-wipeout.evidence: The original composer publishes WipEout INTRO in Slipstream 2 - the Music from wipEout, stating that the track was written for the intro video and the vocals were his.
workbook-09-29-wipeout.verification: Primary artist publication for original Wipeout music, not a licensed compilation claiming all tracks have one composer. Tim Wright and CoLD SToRAGE are the same artist identity, not two distinct composers.

wikipedia-68026802.evidence: Own professional credits identify Advance Wars 1+2: Re-Boot Camp, Maddie Lim, Michaela Nachtigall and Tommy Pedrini, with Arranger & Composer role.
wikipedia-68026802.verification: Primary musician credits; Maddie Lim independently describes music director and lead composer role at https://maddie.vision/. These are the 2023 remake artists, not a substitution of the original GBA score.

wikipedia-75641238.evidence: Official soundtrack credits Composer: Rafael Langoni; Artist: Rafael Langoni, Narek Promtastik Papoyan, Gabriel Marques, Dudu Viana.
wikipedia-75641238.verification: Primary publisher soundtrack product. Publisher Bandcamp has a spelling typo Longoni; canonical name verified in Steam composer field.

wikipedia-76755904.evidence: Arranger Alessandro Garino describes work alongside composer Max LL on Bandle Tale, including clarinet parts for the main theme and Yordle Jazz.
wikipedia-76755904.verification: Primary collaborating musician account; Riot Games original soundtrack credited to Max LL on Apple Music. Arranger is not wrongly credited as sole composer.

wikipedia-77739989.evidence: Official soundtrack description says soundtrack composed by developer Jason Smith; Artist and Composer fields both identify Jason Smith.
wikipedia-77739989.verification: Primary publisher soundtrack product. Current album contains multiple chapters; select Chapter One tracks for original 2022 exhibit, not later Chapter Two or unrelated Cultic metal band.

wikipedia-80588007.evidence: Composer shares a preview of the Fragments sector music he composed for Abiotic Factor.
wikipedia-80588007.verification: Primary composer account for sector music only. Chris Geddes main-theme role appears in transcribed game credits but has not been independently primary-verified in this batch; do not credit the main theme to Mario.

wikipedia-1649463.evidence: Original EA printed manual, PDF page 14/printed page 24, credits Off and Gone (Peak 2 Theme) and Into the Storm (Peak 3 Theme) as Written and Composed by John Morgan.
wikipedia-1649463.verification: Actual original publisher manual scan visually inspected at build/research/composer-primary/ssx-14.jpg. This only supports Morgan original themes, not all licensed songs on the compilation.

wikipedia-15167275.evidence: Contemporary developer audio interview with Criterion audio director Stephen Root includes production credits naming Root, Emney and Sweetman for original music.
wikipedia-15167275.verification: First-person developer production interview in Develop magazine issue 80, not inference from general sound-design roles. Original score distinct from Paradise licensed artist playlist.

wikipedia-2545935.evidence: Official franchise music production account states Jeremy Soule composed the original game music, while Cris Velasco led Company of Heroes 2 and Dynamedion scored 3.
wikipedia-2545935.verification: Primary franchise music production studio account; original 2006 score only, not the 2010 mixed-expansion compilation or unrelated 2013 movie.

wikipedia-74376895.title: BattleBit Remastered
wikipedia-74376895.reason: No original score composer verified. Fan unofficial soundtrack exists and must not be admitted. Developer2023 AMA asks about adding music; insufficient to assert permanent silence.

wikipedia-72151918.title: Butterfly Soup2
wikipedia-72151918.reason: Transcribed original game credits name Miltata/Tatsuya Kobayashi for title track Campagne sound363 plus several other musicians, but direct primary game-credit capture not recovered. Do not infer composer from Brianna Lei developer role.

wikipedia-875392.title: Project Gotham Racing2
wikipedia-875392.reason: Several independent credits identify additional/menu music by David Helpling and Ian Livingstone; primary composer portfolio not recovered. Microsoft original launch confirms licensed artists but does not credit composed menu score.

workbook-03-01-aperture-desk-job.title: Aperture Desk Job
workbook-03-01-aperture-desk-job.reason: Published credits identify Mike Morasky music. Own Twitter statement confirms participation but retrieved quote only discusses JK Simmons recording, so do not overstate it as explicit primary composition credit.
